summary: Full backend (12/12 pytest) + frontend smoke testing for Stonebridge Construction. All core flows work: projects list/filter, inquiry POST, register/login/logout, /me, role-based access, client/projects returns 2 projects for test client, Home/Services/Portfolio/About render, login navigates to /dashboard, dashboard shows Sarah Chen + 2 projects + stats, logout redirects to /login.

ui_bugs.issue: Input lacks name='name' attribute and data-testid; selector input[name='name'] failed. Field is visible with 'Your name' placeholder and likely functional, but not test-friendly.
Lightbox opens (verified visually in screenshot) but lacks data-testid='lightbox' and standard role='dialog'. Close button works via × icon but no data-testid='lightbox-close'.
Progress bars render visually but use plain divs without role='progressbar' or data-testid; reduces accessibility/testability.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/auth/me fires on every page and returns 401 when logged out, generating console errors. Functional but noisy. Consider suppressing or only calling on protected routes.

action_items: Add name='name' attribute and data-testid='inquiry-name' to contact full-name input (and matching data-testids for email/phone/project-type/budget/message/submit).
Add data-testid='lightbox' and data-testid='lightbox-close' to Portfolio lightbox; consider role='dialog'.
Add data-testid attributes to Dashboard progress bars and stat cards; consider role='progressbar' + aria-valuenow.
Silence /api/auth/me 401 console noise on public routes (only call when needed or treat 401 as expected silently).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] when FRONTEND_URL unset, which disables credentials. Production should set FRONTEND_URL to enable cookie-based auth across origins (currently works because frontend and backend share host).
Cookie set with samesite='none', secure=True - correct for cross-site; depends on HTTPS preview (OK).
No brute-force lockout / rate-limit on /api/auth/login. Recommend adding (playbook expects lockout after 5 fails).
google-session: requests is sync inside async handler - blocks event loop. Use httpx.AsyncClient.
server.py is 502 lines and growing; consider splitting routes/models/seed into modules before further features.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 6 projects, 2 client_projects for test client, admin + test client users on startup. Verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All required features pass. Emergent Google Auth button present on /login; full Google flow not browser-testable. Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py is reusable. Remaining items are test-id/a11y polish, not blocking bugs.
